chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Al-Halby, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the woman performing Tamattu' who performs Tawaf by the House and by As-Safa and Al-Marwa for the Hajj, then returns to Mina before she performs Tawaf of the House. So he (peace be upon him) said: 'Does she not visit the House?' I said, 'Yes.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'So let her perform Tawaf.'

key_terms.الصَّفَا: As-Safa (one of the hills between which Sa'i is performed)
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ الْمُتَمَتِّعَةِ: The woman performing Tamattu' (a type of Hajj where Umrah and Hajj are combined with a break in between)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a woman performing Tamattu' Hajj who returns to Mina before completing Tawaf?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the obligation of Tawaf for a woman performing Hajj al-Tamattu' who has already visited the Kaaba but returns to Mina before completing the final circumambulation. The Imam’s rhetorical question, 'Did you not visit the House?', followed by the command 'Let her perform Tawaf,' underscores that the initial visit does not exempt her from the mandatory Tawaf al-Ifadah (or Tawaf al-Ziyarah), emphasizing the completeness of the ritual for valid Hajj. This highlights the Shia scholarly view that Tawaf is a distinct, essential pillar that must be explicitly performed, regardless of prior proximity to the Kaaba.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Al Halby who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the woman performing Tumatto performing Tawaaf by the House (Kabah), and by Al-Safa and Al-Marwa for the Hajj. Then she returns to Mina before she performs Tawaaf of the House (Kabah)’. So heasws said: ‘Did she not visit the House (Kabah)?’ I said, ‘Yes’. Heasws said: ‘So let her perform Tawaaf’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ibn Muskan from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a woman for al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous) who performs Tawaf around the House, performs Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah for al-Hajj; then returns to Mina’ before performing Tawaf around the House. He (the Imam) said, ‘Is it not a fact that she must visit the House?’ I replied, ‘Yes, it is true.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘She then must perform Tawaf.’”
